risks: On this batch it behaves the same as b2r0g0, so it adds no new evidence. Its value is the audit: it records which sibling claims are actually supported.

High-NOT inventories (NOT>=4) are close to the 18-query limit in simulation (a few episodes in ~140 end ambiguous and rely on the most-likely snap). Nothing here changes that tail. The sim truth distribution (uniform split, then uniform table) is an assumption.

Filtering the per-circuit list can hide a circuit's rows entirely ('none right now'). If the joint weighting were miscalibrated for the benchmark's circuit generator, this would steer the model away from rows that are actually informative.
